raw: {"title":"Overview","segments":[{"claimIds":["clm-625e02141e6058b485ab9914"],"text":"The repository's Git history records three commits with subjects \"ORD-12 add order lifecycle\" (2024-01-01), \"PAY-4 add checkout pricing and promotions\" (2024-01-02) and \"ORD-19 document services and model\" (2024-01-03).","layer":"fact","sourceIds":["src-eb6f77d808b91471e95a045b"]},{"claimIds":["clm-cb747712070386e365f9eb5e","clm-383859de29ed26b623a5f3d3"],"text":"docs/architecture.md describes a commerce system in which Checkout coordinates pricing, payment and order placement, calls Promotions over HTTP, and receives payment outcomes as events; the same document lays out the order state flow from pending_payment to confirmed to shipped, with a failed payment moving the order to cancelled.","layer":"intent-evidence","sourceIds":["src-cd630a50f7db9354d29208a9"]},{"claimIds":["clm-f228f87ebe1fe098f85077d6","clm-e8fbe670339b31647ac23769","clm-ce292cf06d729c7965e7ab98","clm-2f96f716b6ac144435d7c349"],"text":"The orders service (services/orders/src/order.go) exports ServiceID 'orders-api' and StoreID 'orders-db'. Its Order struct carries ID, OrderNumber, Contents, State and CreatedDay, with states pending_payment, confirmed, cancelled and shipped. Transition sets Confirmed on the 'payment-captured' event, Cancelled on 'payment-failed' while pending payment, and Shipped on 'shipment-dispatched' while confirmed. It also uses an in-process eventBroker with a Topics map and publishes to topic 'orders'; no document describes this broker.","layer":"fact","sourceIds":["src-35de00d87da95b8d1a68b518"]},{"claimIds":["clm-8f3615f0b47a87650da1ea6f"],"text":"Order expiry is enforced in code: an order reports as expired when the current day minus its CreatedDay is at least 90 and its state is not Shipped, and RunRetentionJob replaces store.Orders with the kept set from PurgeExpired.","layer":"fact","sourceIds":["src-35de00d87da95b8d1a68b518"]},{"claimIds":["clm-bc7f6656e25fb8a55083c1c6","clm-22baef2e845e24949cf40a01","clm-f05845fdce7ad3ee99c5e8ae","clm-7162393d80a03820608781d6"],"text":"The checkout service (services/checkout/src/checkout.ts) exports checkoutService 'checkout-api', modules checkout-cart, checkout-pricing, checkout-payment-step, checkout-confirmation and cartStore 'cart-cache'. It exports a taxRate of 0.08. Its paymentToken builds an object of kind 'PaymentToken' from a vaultReference, and confirmCheckout returns the literal 'orders-api' without performing a remote call.","layer":"fact","sourceIds":["src-0d3fa8b9c9e96b02f486b77a"]},{"claimIds":["clm-ec8bf9c6e5d7d2ed74d0fdb2","clm-500d2596317bacafd4ced53e","clm-2e8cf6eeaf08a9d8e39039c6"],"text":"The promotions service (services/promotions/src/promotions.go) exports ServiceID 'promotions-api' and StoreID 'promotions-db', and computes a discount as subtotal * percent / 100 with integer truncation. On the checkout side, applyPromotion POSTs the orderId to http://promotions-api/internal/apply; no HTTP handler for the apply endpoint appears in the supplied promotions code, and only checkout holds the URL string.","layer":"fact","sourceIds":["src-a9353dc89c7f1ed0d7b6196b","src-0d3fa8b9c9e96b02f486b77a"]},{"claimIds":["clm-909bce98191655679e820ec6","clm-27622e5931eb1cab26f43fbe","clm-75dca9ac291be86228ac60d7","clm-f64cdeacbbfe657f617c8c86","clm-bf994aa29579db67d6a6aa1f"],"text":"The payments service (services/payments/src/payment.ts) exports identifiers payments-api, payments-db, card-vault, card-vault-db, fraud-api, fraud-features, reconciliation-job and reconciliation-db. Its capture function returns 'payment-captured' for a non-empty orderId and 'payment-failed' otherwise, with a code comment stating the order identifier is kept stable across retries so the payment callback is idempotent; it publishes PaymentEvent values to an in-process eventBroker topic 'payments'. The code shows a SettlementReport type with id and total fields whose reconcileSettlement returns the report unchanged; no document mentions settlement reconciliation. README.md and services/orders/README.md state orders are retained indefinitely and remain available forever, which the code contradicts with its 90-day purge of non-shipped
